Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

average noun and adjective

the mean of a set of numbers: on average

also on average, the average, average temperature, above average, below average, on the average

modern

M-O s.v. average: valor medius, numerus medius; average temperature, calor medius (Gauss)

medius, media, medium

adjective

average, mean (of figures)

Classical Latin had no word for an arithmetic mean; the terms are Gauss’s, from medius, middle.

Other words

  • medium, mediī n. — the average, the mean

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · M-O s.v. average (Gauss)

  • mediā habitā ratiōne — on average

    also used · modern · Traupman 93

    Traupman’s phrase, an ablative absolute: “taking the middle reckoning”. Not found in Lewis & Short or the loci.

  • peraequē — equally, evenly, on average

    also used · classical · Lewis & Short; Traupman 275

See also average, count.
